summary: Owned units s0300–s0321 are the Xu Mai appendix after Wang Xizhi. The only explicit calendar label is 永和二年 on the Lin'an western-hills move (s0314). That era is Eastern Jin Emperor Mu (晉穆帝司馬聃), not Han or later homonymous 永和; 晉書穆帝紀 opens Yonghe 1 with a first-month amnesty and treats 二年 as the next annal year, and the 永和 (东晋) conversion table maps 永和二年/丙午 to conventional AD 346. The lunar year can run from early 346 into early 347, but the source gives no month or day, so the conventional year label AD 346 is the right Western form and is not a Gregorian event date. Narrative order is coherent: 未弱冠 visit to Guo Pu; Bao Jing still hidden; parents living while Mai keeps 懸霤 and returns at 朔望; 父母既終, wife née Sun sent home, then mountain wandering and 餌術涉三年 before the Yonghe 2 move; rename 玄/遠遊, farewell letter, Xizhi visits, and the letter citing 左元放 follow that move. One-sided before AD 346 bounds on the parents' lifetime/deaths and the sending-home are justified by that intervening multi-year sequence; visits and letters correctly use onOrAfter 346 rather than after 346. 未弱冠 is kept as an age-at-event and is not turned into a birth year. Chen Anshi, Mao Jiwei, and Zuo Ci are later/place-lore or Han-end citations, not living activity, and do not feed hints. s0320 says Mai's end is unknown (羽化 is later belief); no death year is present, which is correct. No owned unit states a birth. Existing claims and hints match this Chinese sequence.

The year label is conventional and does not claim a Gregorian month/day.
